items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, the only highlight is the Swiss CPI data which is expected to increase to 1.0% vs 0.8% prior. The data won't change anything for the SNB, though, as the central bank remains comfortable keeping monetary policy steady with core inflation within target.  We will also get the final PMIs for the major Eurozone…
